image_description: A side-view photograph of a large sturgeon swimming underwater in greenish, murky water. The fish is dark gray/black on top with visible rows of bony scutes along its back and lateral line. The ventral side appears lighter. The head is elongated with a pointed snout, though the mouth and barbels are partially obscured by the angle and water turbidity. The tail is visible but somewhat blurred by motion or focus.
